payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image background been changed to depict a basketball-court setting?
node.criteria: complete: the background has been replaced with a recognizable basketball-court setting, supported by court cues such as a hoop, basketball, or court-floor markings; the entire court need not be visible. partial: some basketball- or court-related cues appear in the background, but they do not establish a basketball-court setting, or the background change is only partial. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background to a basketball court. unknown: image evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine whether the background depicts a basketball-court setting.
node.binding: Assess the image background, not the foreground subject. Determine from visible image evidence whether the background depicts a basketball-court setting; the whole court need not be visible.

outcome.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.
